velocity.basis: Provisional estimate; sparse checkout has no measured implementation velocity

tasks: Register the opener at platform startup; use sqliteopen WAL/busy-timeout recipe and a separate sharedindex_entries table. Implement mutation, count and namespace methods, preserving signed simhash bits and atomic upserts.
acceptance_criteria: Reopen preserves entries and namespace isolation; delete/count/namespaces match memory backend
Existing brain_frames data remains readable; missing opener and failed open produce explicit errors

tasks: Implement both query methods with lexicographic maxScan prefix and score DESC/key ASC sorting; reuse simhash.Cosine and existing encoders.
acceptance_criteria: Differential fixtures match memory backend for ties, empty data, topK/maxScan boundaries and dimension mismatch
Two independently opened connections share committed writes without namespace collisions

features.description: Runner store options and resource ownership
tasks: Add DB options and setup error propagation; track ownership and close opened handles on normal exit, setup failure and execution failure; update every setup callsite.
acceptance_criteria: No-path options keep existing in-memory behavior
Two Run invocations share frames and index entries; same-file and separate-file modes work
Batch/API contexts do not leak handles or close caller-owned resources

tasks: Add sharedmem-db/sharedindex-db with flag-over-env precedence and capability validation; apply reviewed policy ruling.
acceptance_criteria: Each path without its corresponding cap fails before execution; bad paths fail loudly
Explicit flags override environment; policy flag inventory/hardening tests cover new flags

tasks: Add EffContext Embedder and clone propagation; embed-provider/embed-model flags; reuse messaging factory outside core effects. Distinguish explicit config from the factory default Ollama provider.
acceptance_criteria: No explicit embedding config leaves nil embedder without network calls or warnings
Explicit unsupported provider/missing key fails startup; flag/env/YAML precedence tested
Configured Gemini/OpenAI/Ollama select the requested model; reviewed OpenRouter ruling is reflected

tasks: Register AI/embed through effects.Call and RequireCapWithBudget; classify transport failures into existing AIError records.
acceptance_criteria: Nil embedder returns ProviderNotFound with retryable=false; stub vector succeeds
Authentication, rate limit and timeout errors map correctly; capability and budget denial cannot call provider
Trace and budget behavior matches existing AI operation precedent

tasks: Register _ai_embed with Result[[float], AIError] and export embed; convert float32 vectors to runtime float values without changing existing call APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Import std/ai (embed) type-checks and returns Ok vector or typed Err with stub configuration
Evaluator and strict VM produce equal values/errors for stub cases
Legacy _ollama_embed and existing AI exports retain their behavior

tasks: Add embed-cache/embed-cache-ttl, Go-duration parsing and prerequisite validation. Cache in embed-cache namespace using sha256(resolved model identity + NUL + text); reuse BrainCache storage and existing expiration columns.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated text and cross-run reuse call provider once; changed model misses cache
Hit returns identical vector and still follows AI cap/budget gate; failures are never cached
Expired rows are rejected at lookup as well as GC-on-open; enabled cache without persistent SharedMem and invalid TTL fail explicitly
Cache entries never overwrite unrelated namespaces; cache errors surface explicitly

tasks: Use subprocesses with stub embeddings to prove real restart/process sharing; cover startup cleanup, lock contention, failed provider and TTL.
acceptance_criteria: Writer process exits, reader retrieves memory and both index query forms
Concurrent connections preserve committed state; WAL/busy-timeout and transaction behavior are exercised
No credentials or running Ollama required for automated integration tests

tasks: Correct persistence claims and document all six flags, two path env vars, existing embed config, TTL, caps, linear scans and two-run commands. Add changelog fragment opening with ### .
acceptance_criteria: Both new examples check and run through the stub integration harness against one DB
Help and guide match shipped flag defaults/prerequisites; ANN/read-only brain remain deferred
make test-changed, check-file-sizes, check-changelog, verify-stdlib, verify-examples and check-boundaries pass; simplicity audit regression is reviewed

STOP: commit current work, report BLOCKED: OpenRouter embedding scope ruling required, and end the run
